basic_profile.bio: Hey! I'm a 14-year-old from Lisbon, Portugal. I love gardening and have started growing my own vegetables on our balcony. I'm also a huge fan of Portuguese football. I enjoy staying up late, chatting with friends online, and exploring new hobbies. I'm currently single and mostly hang out with my classmates and online friends. My typical online hours are late at night, especially during weekends and school holidays. I'm still figuring out what I want to be when I grow up, but I'm interested in something related to nature or technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a curious teenager, I learn about gardening through YouTube tutorials and from my grandparents, who have a small farm. I'm self-taught in most things and always eager to learn more, especially about plants and technology.
